change_summary: Route simple conversational turns (confirmations, lookups, identity checks) to claude-haiku-4-5, keeping the configured stronger model only for the first turn and decision-heavy multi-item turns.
reason_for_change: With mean 28.5 turns but only 8.8 tool calls/task, ~20 turns/task are trivial conversational overhead currently paying full model price. Routing those to haiku ($1/$5) instead of opus ($5/$25) or sonnet ($2/$10) yields up to a 5x per-token cost cut on the majority of turns. Keeping the first turn and any turn with complex/decision keywords on the configured strong model protects the success floor, and the policy never upgrades above the configured model so cost can only drop.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.6667 < floor 0.7283
hypothesis: Most turns are simple (identity verification, order lookup, confirmation echoes) and do not need Opus-tier reasoning; routing early/simple turns to claude-haiku-4-5 and reserving sonnet/opus for multi-item decision turns cuts per-token cost 5x on the bulk of turns.
